function floyd_warshall(M::AbstractMatrix)
    n = size(M, 1)
    dist = fill(typemax(eltype(M)), n, n)
    for i in 1:n
        for j in 1:n
            if M[i, j] != 0
                dist[i, j] = M[i, j]
            end
        end
        dist[i, i] = 0
    end
    for k in 1:n, i in 1:n, j in 1:n
        if dist[i, k] != typemax(eltype(M)) && dist[k, j] != typemax(eltype(M))
            dist[i, j] = min(dist[i, j], dist[i, k] + dist[k, j])
        end
    end
    return dist
end

function kabsch_rotation(P::AbstractMatrix, Q::AbstractMatrix)
    C = P' * Q
    U, _, V = svd(C)
    d = sign(det(V * U'))
    R = V * diagm(0 => [1, 1, d]) * U'
    return R
end

function l2_norm(t::AbstractArray; eps::Float32=1.0f-20, dim::Int=-1)
    if dim == -1
        dim = ndims(t)
    end
    norm_val = sqrt.(sum(t .^ 2, dims=dim) .+ eps)
    return t ./ norm_val
end

function len_to_mask(lens::AbstractArray{Int}, max_len::Union{Int,Nothing}=nothing)
    if max_len === nothing
        max_len = maximum(lens)
    end
    batch_dims = size(lens)
    mask = falses(batch_dims..., max_len)
    for idx in CartesianIndices(batch_dims)
        len = lens[idx]
        if len > 0
            mask[idx, 1:len] .= true
        end
    end
    return mask
end

struct LinearNoBias{T}
    weight::AbstractArray{T,2}
end
function LinearNoBias(in_features::Int, out_features::Int; T::Type=Float32)
    weight = randn(T, out_features, in_features) .* sqrt(T(2.0) / in_features)
    return LinearNoBias{T}(weight)
end
function (layer::LinearNoBias)(x::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(x) == 2
        return layer.weight * x
    else
        x_reshaped = reshape(x, size(x, 1), :)
        out_reshaped = layer.weight * x_reshaped
        return reshape(out_reshaped, size(layer.weight, 1), size(x)[2:end]...)
    end
end

struct LayerNorm{T}
    gamma::AbstractArray{T,1}
    beta::AbstractArray{T,1}
    eps::T
end
function LayerNorm(dim::Int; eps::Float32=1.0f-5, elementwise_affine::Bool=true, T::Type=Float32)
    if elementwise_affine
        gamma = ones(T, dim)
        beta = zeros(T, dim)
    else
        gamma = zeros(T, 0)
        beta = zeros(T, 0)
    end
    LayerNorm{T}(gamma, beta, T(eps))
end
function (layer::LayerNorm)(x::AbstractArray)
    dims_to_norm = (ndims(x),)
    mean_x = mean(x, dims=dims_to_norm)
    var_x = var(x, dims=dims_to_norm, corrected=false)
    x_norm = (x .- mean_x) ./ sqrt.(var_x .+ layer.eps)
    if length(layer.gamma) > 0
        return x_norm .* reshape(layer.gamma, (1 for _ in 1:ndims(x)-1)..., :) .+ reshape(layer.beta, (1 for _ in 1:ndims(x)-1)..., :)
    else
        return x_norm
    end
end

function PreLayerNorm(fn, dim::Int)

function swish(x)

struct SwiGLU end
function (::SwiGLU)(x::AbstractArray)
    dim_half = size(x, 1) ÷ 2
    x_part = x[1:dim_half, ..]
    gates = x[dim_half+1:end, ..]
    return swish(gates) .* x_part
end

struct Transition{T}
    linear1::LinearNoBias{T}
    activation::SwiGLU
    linear2::LinearNoBias{T}
end
function Transition(dim::Int; expansion_factor::Float32=2.0f0, T::Type=Float32)
    dim_inner = Int(dim * expansion_factor)
    linear1 = LinearNoBias(dim, dim_inner * 2; T=T)
    linear2 = LinearNoBias(dim_inner, dim; T=T)
    return Transition{T}(linear1, SwiGLU(), linear2)
end
function (layer::Transition)(x::AbstractArray)
    x1 = layer.linear1(x)
    x2 = layer.activation(x1)
    return layer.linear2(x2)
end

function parse_fasta(filename::String)::Dict{String, String}
    sequences = Dict{String, String}()
    open(filename) do f
        lines = readlines(f)
        i = 1
        while i <= length(lines)
            if startswith(lines[i], ">")
                header = lines[i][2:end]
                i += 1
                seq_parts = []
                while i <= length(lines) && !startswith(lines[i], ">")
                    push!(seq_parts, strip(lines[i]))
                    i += 1
                end
                sequences[header] = join(seq_parts)
            else
                i += 1
            end
        end
    end
    return sequences
end

function download_alphafold_proteome(db::AlphaFoldDatabase, organism::String; force_download::Bool=false)
    if !haskey(ALPHAFOLDPROTEOMES, organism)
        error("Unknown organism: $organism. Available keys: $(keys(ALPHAFOLDPROTEOMES))")
    end
    filename = ALPHAFOLDPROTEOMES[organism]
    url = ALPHAFOLDDBBASE * filename
    local_path = joinpath(db.cache_dir, filename)

    if !isfile(local_path) || force_download
        println("Downloading AlphaFold proteome for $(get(ORGANISMNAMES, organism, organism))...")
        try
            Downloads.download(url, local_path)
            println("Download completed: $local_path")
        catch e
            error("Failed to download organism proteome: $e")
        end
    else
        println("Using cached proteome: $local_path")
    end
    push!(db.downloaded_proteomes, organism)
    return local_path
end

function extract_alphafold_proteome(db::AlphaFoldDatabase, organism::String)
    if !(organism in db.downloaded_proteomes)
        download_alphafold_proteome(db, organism)
    end
    filename = ALPHAFOLDPROTEOMES[organism]
    archive_path = joinpath(db.cache_dir, filename)
    extract_dir = joinpath(db.cache_dir, replace(filename, ".tar" => ""))

    if !isdir(extract_dir)
        println("Extracting AlphaFold archive: $filename")
        mkpath(extract_dir)
        try
            run(`tar -xf $archive_path -C $extract_dir`)
            println("Extraction completed: $extract_dir")
        catch e
            error("Failed to extract archive: $archive_path. Error: $e")
        end
    else
        println("Using extracted directory: $extract_dir")
    end
    return extract_dir
end

function parse_alphafold_pdb(pdb_file::String)
    sequence = ""
    coordinates = Float32[]
    confidence_scores = Float32[]
    open(pdb_file, "r") do f
        for line in eachline(f)
            if startswith(line, "ATOM") && occursin(" CA ", line)
                aa_3_letter = strip(line[18:20])
                aa_1_letter_map = Dict("ALA"=>'A', "ARG"=>'R', "ASN"=>'N', "ASP"=>'D', "CYS"=>'C', "GLN"=>'Q', "GLU"=>'E', "GLY"=>'G', "HIS"=>'H', "ILE"=>'I', "LEU"=>'L', "LYS"=>'K', "MET"=>'M', "PHE"=>'F', "PRO"=>'P', "SER"=>'S', "THR"=>'T', "TRP"=>'W', "TYR"=>'Y', "VAL"=>'V')
                aa = get(aa_1_letter_map, aa_3_letter, 'X')
                sequence *= aa
                x = parse(Float32, line[31:38])
                y = parse(Float32, line[39:46])
                z = parse(Float32, line[47:54])
                append!(coordinates, [x, y, z])
                bfactor = parse(Float32, line[61:66])
                push!(confidence_scores, bfactor)
            end
        end
    end
    n_res = length(sequence)
    coords_array = reshape(coordinates, 3, n_res)
    coords_3d = permutedims(coords_array, (2, 1))
    coords_3d = reshape(coords_3d, n_res, 1, 3)
    return sequence, coords_3d, confidence_scores
end

function load_alphafold_protein(db::AlphaFoldDatabase, organism::String, uniprot_id::String)
    extract_dir = extract_alphafold_proteome(db, organism)
    pdb_file = ""
    for (root, dirs, files) in walkdir(extract_dir)
        for file in files
            if occursin(uniprot_id, file) && endswith(file, ".pdb")
                pdb_file = joinpath(root, file)
                break
            end
        end
        if pdb_file != ""
            break
        end
    end

    if isempty(pdb_file)
        error("PDB file not found for UniProt ID $uniprot_id in organism $organism")
    end

    println("Loading AlphaFold structure: $pdb_file")
    sequence, coordinates, confidence_scores = parse_alphafold_pdb(pdb_file)
    entry = Dict("uniprot_id"=>uniprot_id, "organism"=>organism, "sequence"=>sequence, "coordinates"=>coordinates, "confidence_plddt"=>confidence_scores)
    db.loaded_entries[uniprot_id] = entry
    println("Loaded protein $uniprot_id ($(length(sequence)) residues)")
    return entry
end

function save_to_pdb(coords::AbstractArray, sequence::String, plddt::AbstractVector, filename::String)
    open(filename, "w") do f

            x, y, z = coords[i, 1, 1], coords[i, 1, 2], coords[i, 1, 3]
            bfactor = plddt[i]

        end
        println(f, "END")
    end
end
